prompt: Which sentence should replace the entire second sentence of the draft (“Once the runner leaves it, they write down the time”) to describe the acknowledgement step correctly?
promptZh: 哪一句應完整取代草稿中的第二句（「跑腿人員放下箱子後，他們記下時間」），才能正確說明確認領取這一步？

options.text: The runner enters the drop-off time in the acknowledgement record.
options.zh: 跑腿人員在確認領取紀錄上填寫放下箱子的時間。
options.whyZh: 放箱時間屬於送達紀錄。跑腿人員只有送達紀錄表，確認領取紀錄也不是用來記放箱時間。

options.text: The desk worker enters the drop-off time in the acknowledgement record.
options.zh: 櫃檯人員在確認領取紀錄上填寫放下箱子的時間。
options.whyZh: 櫃檯人員可以填確認領取紀錄，但要填實際領到的時間，不是較早的放箱時間。

options.text: The runner enters the time at which the desk worker collected the box.
options.zh: 由跑腿人員填寫櫃檯人員領到箱子的時間。
options.whyZh: 實際領到的時間符合確認領取的定義，但跑腿人員只有送達紀錄表，也通常在接班者到班前先離開。

options.text: The desk worker records when the box is collected.
options.zh: 由櫃檯人員填寫自己領到箱子的時間。
options.whyZh: 確認領取記的是有人實際拿到箱子的時間。櫃檯接班者負責填該紀錄，因此應記自己領到箱子的時間。

explanationZh: 確認領取記的是有人實際拿到箱子的時間。櫃檯接班者負責填該紀錄，因此應記自己領到箱子的時間。
evidence: An acknowledgement means someone at the desk has actually collected it. / The runner sets the box down and has only the delivery sheet. / The person taking over the desk can write in the acknowledgement record. / The runner usually leaves before the desk worker arrives. / Once the runner leaves it, they write down the time.

vocabulary.note: take over 表示接手另一人的工作。
